sections.title: Example 1: Basic Pca Implementation
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 1: Basic PCA Implementation")
print("-" * 65)

# Generate synthetic high-dimensional data
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 500
n_features = 20

# Create correlated features
X = np.random.randn(n_samples, n_features)

# Add correlations between features
X[:, 1] = 0.7 * X[:, 0] + 0.3 * np.random.randn(n_samples)
X[:, 2] = 0.6 * X[:, 0] + 0.4 * X[:, 1] + 0.2 * np.random.randn(n_samples)
X[:, 3] = 0.5 * X[:, 1] + 0.5 * np.random.randn(n_samples)

print(f"Original dataset shape: {X.shape}")
print(f"Original features: {X.shape[1]}")

# Scale the data (important for PCA)
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# Apply PCA
pca_basic = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca_basic.fit_transform(X_scaled)

print(f"\nPCA Results:")
print(f"Reduced dataset shape: {X_pca.shape}")
print(f"Reduced features: {X_pca.shape[1]}")
print(
    f"Dimensionality reduction: {((X.shape[1] - X_pca.shape[1]) / X.shape[1]) * 100:.1f}%"
)

# Explained variance analysis
explained_variance_ratio = pca_basic.explained_variance_ratio_
cumulative_variance = np.cumsum(explained_variance_ratio)

print(f"\nExplained Variance Analysis:")
print(
    f"PC1 explained variance: {explained_variance_ratio[0]:.4f} ({explained_variance_ratio[0]*100:.1f}%)"
)
print(
    f"PC2 explained variance: {explained_variance_ratio[1]:.4f} ({explained_variance_ratio[1]*100:.1f}%)"
)
print(
    f"Cumulative explained variance: {cumulative_variance[1]:.4f} ({cumulative_variance[1]*100:.1f}%)"
)

# Component loadings
print(f"\nComponent Loadings (first 5 features):")
print("Feature\t\tPC1\t\tPC2")
print("-" * 40)
for i in range(min(5, X.shape[1])):
    print(
        f"Feature {i+1}\t\t{pca_basic.components_[0, i]:.4f}\t\t{pca_basic.components_[1, i]:.4f}"
    )

joblib.dump(pca_basic, "models/pca_example1_basic.pkl")
print("Basic PCA model saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 2: Component Selection Methods
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 2: Component Selection Methods")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate data for component selection
np.random.seed(42)
X_comp = np.random.randn(300, 15)

# Add some structure
X_comp[:, 1] = 0.8 * X_comp[:, 0] + 0.2 * np.random.randn(300)
X_comp[:, 2] = 0.7 * X_comp[:, 0] + 0.3 * np.random.randn(300)
X_comp[:, 3] = 0.6 * X_comp[:, 1] + 0.4 * np.random.randn(300)

print(f"Component selection dataset shape: {X_comp.shape}")

# Scale the data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_comp_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_comp)

# Method 1: Fixed number of components
pca_fixed = PCA(n_components=5)
X_pca_fixed = pca_fixed.fit_transform(X_comp_scaled)
variance_fixed = np.sum(pca_fixed.explained_variance_ratio_)

# Method 2: Explained variance threshold
pca_threshold = PCA(n_components=0.95)
X_pca_threshold = pca_threshold.fit_transform(X_comp_scaled)
n_components_threshold = X_pca_threshold.shape[1]
variance_threshold = np.sum(pca_threshold.explained_variance_ratio_)

# Method 3: All components for analysis
pca_all = PCA()
pca_all.fit(X_comp_scaled)
eigenvalues = pca_all.explained_variance_

# Kaiser criterion (eigenvalue > 1)
kaiser_components = np.sum(eigenvalues > 1)

print(f"\nComponent Selection Results:")
print("-" * 50)
print(f"{'Method':<25s} {'Components':<12s} {'Variance':<12s}")
print("-" * 50)
print(f"{'Fixed (5 components)':<25s} {5:<12d} {variance_fixed:<12.4f}")
print(
    f"{'Threshold (95%)':<25s} {n_components_threshold:<12d} {variance_threshold:<12.4f}"
)
print(
    f"{'Kaiser criterion':<25s} {kaiser_components:<12d} {np.sum(pca_all.explained_variance_ratio_[:kaiser_components]):<12.4f}"
)

# Scree plot analysis
print(f"\nEigenvalue Analysis:")
print("Component\tEigenvalue\tExplained Variance")
print("-" * 50)
for i in range(min(10, len(eigenvalues))):
    print(
        f"{i+1}\t\t{eigenvalues[i]:.4f}\t\t{pca_all.explained_variance_ratio_[i]:.4f}"
    )

joblib.dump(pca_threshold, "models/pca_example2_component_selection.pkl")
print("Component selection PCA model saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 3: Pca with Different Scaling Methods
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 3: PCA with Different Scaling Methods")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate data with different scales
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 400

# Create features with different scales
feature1 = np.random.normal(0, 1, n_samples)  # Scale ~1
feature2 = np.random.normal(0, 100, n_samples)  # Scale ~100
feature3 = np.random.normal(0, 0.01, n_samples)  # Scale ~0.01
feature4 = np.random.normal(0, 10, n_samples)  # Scale ~10

X_scaling = np.column_stack([feature1, feature2, feature3, feature4])

# Add some correlations
X_scaling[:, 1] = 0.7 * X_scaling[:, 0] + 0.3 * np.random.normal(0, 100, n_samples)
X_scaling[:, 2] = 0.6 * X_scaling[:, 0] + 0.4 * np.random.normal(0, 0.01, n_samples)

print("Feature scales before scaling:")
print(f"Feature 1: mean={X_scaling[:, 0].mean():.4f}, std={X_scaling[:, 0].std():.4f}")
print(f"Feature 2: mean={X_scaling[:, 1].mean():.4f}, std={X_scaling[:, 1].std():.4f}")
print(f"Feature 3: mean={X_scaling[:, 2].mean():.4f}, std={X_scaling[:, 2].std():.4f}")
print(f"Feature 4: mean={X_scaling[:, 3].mean():.4f}, std={X_scaling[:, 3].std():.4f}")

# PCA without scaling
pca_no_scale = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca_no_scale = pca_no_scale.fit_transform(X_scaling)
variance_no_scale = np.sum(pca_no_scale.explained_variance_ratio_)

# PCA with StandardScaler
scaler_std = StandardScaler()
X_scaled_std = scaler_std.fit_transform(X_scaling)
pca_std = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca_std = pca_std.fit_transform(X_scaled_std)
variance_std = np.sum(pca_std.explained_variance_ratio_)

# PCA with MinMaxScaler
scaler_minmax = MinMaxScaler()
X_scaled_minmax = scaler_minmax.fit_transform(X_scaling)
pca_minmax = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca_minmax = pca_minmax.fit_transform(X_scaled_minmax)
variance_minmax = np.sum(pca_minmax.explained_variance_ratio_)

print(f"\nPCA Results with Different Scaling:")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'Method':<20s} {'PC1 Variance':<15s} {'PC2 Variance':<15s} {'Total':<10s}")
print("-" * 60)
print(
    f"{'No Scaling':<20s} {pca_no_scale.explained_variance_ratio_[0]:<15.4f} {pca_no_scale.explained_variance_ratio_[1]:<15.4f} {variance_no_scale:<10.4f}"
)
print(
    f"{'StandardScaler':<20s} {pca_std.explained_variance_ratio_[0]:<15.4f} {pca_std.explained_variance_ratio_[1]:<15.4f} {variance_std:<10.4f}"
)
print(
    f"{'MinMaxScaler':<20s} {pca_minmax.explained_variance_ratio_[0]:<15.4f} {pca_minmax.explained_variance_ratio_[1]:<15.4f} {variance_minmax:<10.4f}"
)

print(f"\nKey Insight: StandardScaler provides the most balanced variance distribution")

joblib.dump(pca_std, "models/pca_example3_scaling.pkl")
print("Scaled PCA model saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 4: Pca for Visualization
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 4: PCA for Visualization")
print("-" * 70)

# Load iris dataset for visualization
iris = load_iris()
X_iris = iris.data
y_iris = iris.target
feature_names = iris.feature_names

print(f"Iris dataset shape: {X_iris.shape}")
print(f"Feature names: {feature_names}")

# Scale the data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_iris_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_iris)

# Apply PCA for 2D visualization
pca_viz = PCA(n_components=2)
X_iris_pca = pca_viz.fit_transform(X_iris_scaled)

print(f"\nPCA Visualization Results:")
print(f"Original dimensions: {X_iris.shape[1]}")
print(f"Reduced dimensions: {X_iris_pca.shape[1]}")
print(f"Explained variance: {np.sum(pca_viz.explained_variance_ratio_):.4f}")

# Component loadings analysis
print(f"\nComponent Loadings:")
print("Feature\t\t\tPC1\t\tPC2")
print("-" * 50)
for i, feature in enumerate(feature_names):
    print(
        f"{feature:<20s} {pca_viz.components_[0, i]:<12.4f} {pca_viz.components_[1, i]:<12.4f}"
    )

# Feature importance (absolute loadings)
print(f"\nFeature Importance (absolute loadings):")
print("Feature\t\t\tPC1\t\tPC2\t\tTotal")
print("-" * 60)
for i, feature in enumerate(feature_names):
    pc1_importance = abs(pca_viz.components_[0, i])
    pc2_importance = abs(pca_viz.components_[1, i])
    total_importance = pc1_importance + pc2_importance
    print(
        f"{feature:<20s} {pc1_importance:<12.4f} {pc2_importance:<12.4f} {total_importance:<12.4f}"
    )

joblib.dump(pca_viz, "models/pca_example4_visualization.pkl")
print("Visualization PCA model saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 5: Pca for Noise Reduction
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 5: PCA for Noise Reduction")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate data with noise
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 300
n_features = 10

# Create clean data with structure
X_clean = np.random.randn(n_samples, n_features)
X_clean[:, 1] = 0.8 * X_clean[:, 0] + 0.2 * np.random.randn(n_samples)
X_clean[:, 2] = 0.7 * X_clean[:, 0] + 0.3 * np.random.randn(n_samples)

# Add noise
noise_level = 0.5
X_noisy = X_clean + noise_level * np.random.randn(n_samples, n_features)

print(f"Noise reduction dataset shape: {X_noisy.shape}")
print(f"Noise level: {noise_level}")

# Scale the data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_noisy_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_noisy)

# Apply PCA with different component counts
n_components_list = [2, 3, 5, 7, 10]
results_noise = {}

print(f"\nPCA Noise Reduction Results:")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'Components':<12s} {'Explained Var':<15s} {'Reconstruction Error':<20s}")
print("-" * 60)

for n_comp in n_components_list:
    pca = PCA(n_components=n_comp)
    X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_noisy_scaled)

    # Reconstruct data
    X_reconstructed = pca.inverse_transform(X_pca)

    # Calculate reconstruction error
    reconstruction_error = np.mean((X_noisy_scaled - X_reconstructed) ** 2)
    explained_variance = np.sum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)

    results_noise[n_comp] = {
        "explained_variance": explained_variance,
        "reconstruction_error": reconstruction_error,
        "model": pca,
    }

    print(f"{n_comp:<12d} {explained_variance:<15.4f} {reconstruction_error:<20.4f}")

# Find optimal number of components
best_components = min(
    results_noise.keys(), key=lambda x: results_noise[x]["reconstruction_error"]
)
print(f"\nOptimal number of components: {best_components}")

joblib.dump(
    results_noise[best_components]["model"], "models/pca_example5_noise_reduction.pkl"
)
print("Noise reduction PCA model saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 6: Pca for Feature Engineering
sections.body:
```python
print("\n\nExample 6: PCA for Feature Engineering")
print("-" * 70)

# Load breast cancer dataset
cancer = load_breast_cancer()
X_cancer = cancer.data
y_cancer = cancer.target

print(f"Breast cancer dataset shape: {X_cancer.shape}")

# Split data
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X_cancer, y_cancer, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Scale the data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# Test different PCA configurations
n_components_list = [5, 10, 15, 20, 25]
results_feature = {}

print(f"\nPCA Feature Engineering Results:")
print("-" * 70)
print(f"{'Components':<12s} {'Explained Var':<15s} {'Accuracy':<12s} {'CV Score':<12s}")
print("-" * 70)

for n_comp in n_components_list:
    # Apply PCA
    pca = PCA(n_components=n_comp)
    X_train_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_train_scaled)
    X_test_pca = pca.transform(X_test_scaled)

    # Train classifier
    clf = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000)
    clf.fit(X_train_pca, y_train)

    # Evaluate
    y_pred = clf.predict(X_test_pca)
    accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)

    # Cross-validation
    cv_scores = cross_val_score(clf, X_train_pca, y_train, cv=5)
    cv_mean = cv_scores.mean()

    explained_variance = np.sum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)

    results_feature[n_comp] = {
        "explained_variance": explained_variance,
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "cv_score": cv_mean,
        "model": pca,
        "classifier": clf,
    }

    print(
        f"{n_comp:<12d} {explained_variance:<15.4f} {accuracy:<12.4f} {cv_mean:<12.4f}"
    )

# Find best configuration
best_config = max(results_feature.keys(), key=lambda x: results_feature[x]["cv_score"])
print(f"\nBest configuration: {best_config} components")

joblib.dump(
    results_feature[best_config]["model"], "models/pca_example6_feature_engineering.pkl"
)
print("Feature engineering PCA model saved to: models/")
```

sections.title: Example 7: Comprehensive Pca Analysis
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Create complex data structure
- Apply PCA with all components for analysis
- Analyze eigenvalues and explained variance
- Find optimal number of components using different methods
- Method 1: Kaiser criterion
- Method 2: 95% variance threshold
- Method 3: Elbow method (simplified)
- Choose best configuration (highest explained variance)

```python
print("\n\nExample 7: Comprehensive PCA Analysis")
print("-" * 70)

# Generate comprehensive dataset
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = 600
n_features = 25

# Create complex data structure
X_comp = np.random.randn(n_samples, n_features)

# Add multiple correlations
X_comp[:, 1] = 0.8 * X_comp[:, 0] + 0.2 * np.random.randn(n_samples)
X_comp[:, 2] = 0.7 * X_comp[:, 0] + 0.3 * np.random.randn(n_samples)
X_comp[:, 3] = 0.6 * X_comp[:, 1] + 0.4 * np.random.randn(n_samples)
X_comp[:, 4] = 0.5 * X_comp[:, 2] + 0.5 * np.random.randn(n_samples)

# Add some noise
X_comp += 0.1 * np.random.randn(n_samples, n_features)

print(f"Comprehensive dataset shape: {X_comp.shape}")

# Scale the data
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_comp_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_comp)

# Apply PCA with all components for analysis
pca_full = PCA()
pca_full.fit(X_comp_scaled)

# Analyze eigenvalues and explained variance
eigenvalues = pca_full.explained_variance_
explained_variance_ratio = pca_full.explained_variance_ratio_
cumulative_variance = np.cumsum(explained_variance_ratio)

print(f"\nComprehensive PCA Analysis:")
print("-" * 70)
print(
    f"{'Component':<12s} {'Eigenvalue':<12s} {'Explained Var':<15s} {'Cumulative':<12s}"
)
print("-" * 70)

for i in range(min(10, len(eigenvalues))):
    print(
        f"{i+1:<12d} {eigenvalues[i]:<12.4f} {explained_variance_ratio[i]:<15.4f} {cumulative_variance[i]:<12.4f}"
    )

# Find optimal number of components using different methods
# Method 1: Kaiser criterion
kaiser_components = np.sum(eigenvalues > 1)

# Method 2: 95% variance threshold
variance_95_idx = np.where(cumulative_variance >= 0.95)[0]
variance_95_components = (
    variance_95_idx[0] + 1 if len(variance_95_idx) > 0 else len(eigenvalues)
)

# Method 3: Elbow method (simplified)
elbow_components = 5  # Based on visual inspection

print(f"\nComponent Selection Analysis:")
print(f"Kaiser criterion (>1): {kaiser_components} components")
print(f"95% variance threshold: {variance_95_components} components")
print(f"Elbow method: {elbow_components} components")

# Test different configurations
configurations = [kaiser_components, variance_95_components, elbow_components]
results_comprehensive = {}

print(f"\nConfiguration Comparison:")
print("-" * 60)
print(f"{'Method':<20s} {'Components':<12s} {'Explained Var':<15s}")
print("-" * 60)

for config in configurations:
    pca = PCA(n_components=config)
    X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_comp_scaled)
    explained_variance = np.sum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)

    results_comprehensive[config] = {
        "explained_variance": explained_variance,
        "model": pca,
    }

    method_name = f"Method {config}"
    print(f"{method_name:<20s} {config:<12d} {explained_variance:<15.4f}")

# Choose best configuration (highest explained variance)
best_config = max(
    results_comprehensive.keys(),
    key=lambda x: results_comprehensive[x]["explained_variance"],
)
best_model = results_comprehensive[best_config]["model"]

print(f"\nSelected configuration: {best_config} components")
print(
    f"Explained variance: {results_comprehensive[best_config]['explained_variance']:.4f}"
)

# Final analysis
X_final_pca = best_model.fit_transform(X_comp_scaled)

print(f"\nFinal PCA Results:")
print(f"Original dimensions: {X_comp.shape[1]}")
print(f"Reduced dimensions: {X_final_pca.shape[1]}")
print(
    f"Dimensionality reduction: {((X_comp.shape[1] - X_final_pca.shape[1]) / X_comp.shape[1]) * 100:.1f}%"
)
print(
    f"Information preserved: {results_comprehensive[best_config]['explained_variance'] * 100:.1f}%"
)

joblib.dump(best_model, "models/pca_example7_comprehensive.pkl")
print("Comprehensive PCA model saved to: models/")
```
